
---mode: agentdescription: Batch 11d. Friendlier shell, plain wording, readable money, and first-run steps. Markup only. About 40K tokens.---
Build batch 11d only. Markup and wording only. No new rules, no data changes, and no CSS: `styles.css` already has every class named here.
Read: `.github/prompts/PROGRESS.md`, `src/domain/value.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ActivityView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SpendForm.tsx`, `src/ui/views/BalancesView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/AccountsView.tsx`.
## Classes available
- `nav-group`: a small heading in the sidebar.- `card`: a white panel. `section-heading`: an `h2` row with an optional action on the right.- `hint`: muted helper text. `muted`: muted text.- `amount positive` is green, and `amount negative` is red.- `allocation-tag`, plus `house` for House: entity chips.- `steps`: a numbered `ol`. An `li` with `done` shows a tick.- `icon-button`: a small square button. Give it an `aria-label`.- `danger`: a destructive button. `text-button`: a link-style button.- `banner warning`: an amber banner. `status-chip`: a small pill.
## Build
1. `value.ts`: add `formatMoney(cents)`, giving `$1,234.56`, `−$85.40`, and `$0.00`. Use a real minus sign. Keep `formatAud` unchanged. Views switch to `formatMoney`. Tests keep `formatAud`.2. `LocalApp.tsx`.   - Sidebar: `Finance`, then a `nav-group` "Daily" with Review, Activity, Settle, Balances, Import, then "Setup" with Accounts, People, Data.   - Open on Review when rows are waiting, otherwise on Activity.   - Topbar: the file name, or "No file open". When there are unsaved changes, show a `status-chip` "Unsaved". Then Open (`secondary`), Save as (`secondary`), and Save (`primary`).   - Cmd or Ctrl+S saves.   - A success message clears after 4 seconds, and when the view changes. An error stays until the next action.3. First run. In `ActivityView`, when there are no accounts, replace the empty table with a `card` holding a `steps` list. Mark each step `done` when it is true, and give each a button to its view, through a new optional `onNavigate(view)` prop:   - "Add your bank accounts", which opens Accounts.   - "Add people and groups you share costs with", which opens People.   - "Import a CSV from your bank", which opens Import.   - "Review the imported rows", which opens Review.4. Wording, everywhere in these files.   - "Payer" and "Payer entity" become "Paid by". "Portions" becomes "Split". "Entity" in a split row becomes "For". "Portion (AUD)" becomes "Amount".   - "You is the payer; allocations must equal the spend amount." becomes "Paid by {name}. Split the full amount." Use "You paid" for self.   - "House money" becomes a chip, `allocation-tag house` "House".   - In Activity, the "Balances" column becomes "Counts", showing "Yes", or "No" in `muted`. "Include selected" and "Exclude selected" become "Count in balances" and "Keep out of balances".5. `SpendForm.tsx`.   - Each split row: For, Amount, and an `icon-button` "×" with `aria-label="Remove {name}"`.   - Under the rows: "Left to split: {money}" in `amount positive` when it is 0, and in `banner warning` style text otherwise.   - Buttons: "Add person", and "All to {payer name}".   - The effect sentence uses chips: "{chip} owes you $x".6. `ActivityView.tsx`: under the description, show one chip per split entity other than the payer. Self shows no chip. Bank-row detail stays one muted line.7. `BalancesView.tsx`.   - Each balance reads "{name} owes you $x" in `amount positive`, "You owe {name} $x" in `amount negative`, or "Settled" in `muted`.   - Opening balances move behind a `secondary` button "Edit opening balances", which shows the input column. They are hidden by default.   - Hide "Between others" when it is empty.8. `AccountsView.tsx`: the Paid by column shows chips. A checkpoint difference that is not zero uses `amount negative`.

## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Open `npm run dev` and check that the four first-run steps show on an empty ledger. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 11e.
